ownerDirective.speaker: Governor
ownerDirective.exactText: i'm the governmor of the minecraft world and I've come to cut red tape
ownerDirective.interpretation: The finite mid-shaft recovery-lighting scope is delegated to the implementation team; hard safety is not waived.

mvpBoundary.included: Only two retained-ceiling static recovery fixtures and their existing crossover interfaces.
mvpBoundary.exclusionRule: No emergency lighting system, public route, passenger service, rail power, or signal is authorized.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact retained-ceiling replacement/inverse and independent QA are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled; failure invokes exact reverse rollback.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact recovery-lighting scope.
